Category-Theoretic Metriplectic

Plans

Papers

Here I will begin with a list of papers to use for my research in this study

  • Baez, Weisbart & Yassine — Open systems in classical mechanics

  • John C. Baez & Christopher L. Rogers — Categorified Symplectic Geometry and the String Lie 2-Algebra (2008/2009)

  • Alan Weinstein — Symplectic categories (survey/paper,  2009)

  • Brendan Fong — Decorated Cospans (2015) & related work (Baez–Fong, Baez–Fong–Pollard)

  • John C. Baez — expository / historical pieces on n-categorical physics

  • P. Guha — Metriplectic structure, Leibniz dynamics and dissipative systems

  • Work on double categories / structured cospans for open dynamical systems (Courser thesis; Kenny Courser; “Open Systems: A Double Categorical Perspective”)
